prerequisites.details: The needed mathematical operations arrive through concrete earlier links or are introduced locally. 14.1 reestablishes Q/K point comparison and positions, then teaches the two-coordinate arrow, sin/cos, radians and the actual rotation before its code; its negative dot product is explicitly not a probability. 14.2 explains feature-axis mean/variance versus RMS and affine parameters, while14.3 distinguishes Q/K L2 scaling from RMSNorm. Activations, gates and table sharing use the earlier FFN, embedding and vocabulary-logit concepts. I read complete chapter04, relevant03 attention/head sections,02.1, and W.4-W.6 to verify those meanings. MoE begins from a fully computed Dense FFN before independently stored experts, router scores, top-k and retained coefficients; discrete indices and continuous gradient paths are kept distinct. The auxiliary objective is introduced with its own denominator and coefficient before interpreting load statistics. Measurement begins with familiar TinyLM components and introduces profiler terms, median, MiB and allocator scope. Cache position offsets, causal masking, padding and valid target totals are explained before optimizations depend on them. Quantization explicitly explains signed codes, scale, offset, actual integer containers and bit operations before packing. QAT introduces the STE approximation before its detach formula and differentiates it from the real derivative of round. Distillation first separates text-only from accessible logits, then vocabulary identity, temperature, frozen targets and forward-KL direction before mixing CE and KL. I read the relevant split/optimizer/evaluation, BPB/byte, chat-label/EOS/temperature, style/honesty, tool-policy, image-expansion/VQA and audio/joint-teacher foundations; the exact scopes are in reading-scope-receipts.json. In18.13, query15 versus answer-input16 and query3 versus answer-input4 follow the earlier once-shifted chat/image rules, not an unexplained new alignment. terminology.details: Terms keep their roles across chapters: token ID versus sequence index, feature width versus number of heads, learned weight versus intermediate feature, Dense versus independent experts, total parameters versus per-token capacity proxy, causal permission versus target-loss selection, and code range versus stored byte container remain separate. 14.6 explains sharing the same Parameter rather than merely copying equal initial numbers. In15, top-1 keeps its original softmax coefficient while top-2 renormalizes retained coefficients;15.7 explicitly proves that normalized singleton p/p destroys that particular task gradient, without generalizing to all routers. PAD-excluded routing statistics do not claim skipped expert computation. In16, one KV group shared by four queries is identified as the MQA endpoint within GQA, and the newly initialized K/V projections are distinguished from the source model and the original GQA conversion recipe. Cache contains each layer's K/V, with new-query position offset; prefill and decode measure different work. SDPA is an API choice, not proof of Flash dispatch; its boolean True permits attention and its default scale must not be applied twice. The memory plot has a common allocated baseline plus new allocations, not total-card or reserved memory. Activation checkpointing is distinct from saved model checkpoints, and AMP operation dtypes do not imply low-bit saved weights. In17, signed packing accepts -8..7 while the symmetric quantizer uses -7..7; integer-code packing is lossless but float-to-grid quantization is not. Packed weight buffers, scales, float bias, remaining float parameters, file metadata and optimizer state are differentiated. This tool unpacks and restores FP32 for a reference computation rather than claiming an integer inference kernel. In18, teacher logit softening uses T and helper-internal T² once, not the generation sampling temperature; forward KL(p_teacher||q_student) remains separate from reverse KL and the library argument order is explained. Valid labels choose positions for KL, not the teacher candidate probability indexed by a standard answer. Current narrow recheck: I reread the full affected16.1/T.8 contexts. examples_and_exercises.details: All assigned exercises are specific changes to the immediately explained example with a prediction to check. RoPE varies relative distance; normalization/gates/table sharing keep shape and identity questions local. MoE exercises vary top-k, retained weights, expert outputs, dispatch indices, load coefficient and capacity without pretending that a toy route is trained language quality. The dispatch SVG and worked row2 addition prepare index_add and prevent duplicate-return overwrites. Router-output halving correctly makes its squared-loss gradient one quarter, while normalized top-1 remains zero. The efficiency exercises compare full/cached states after the same new token, change prefixes with cache rebuilding, distinguish padding statistics from changed attention, divide accumulated loss by the shared valid-target total before one optimizer step, and compare SDPA shape/numerics before backend/time claims. The online-softmax SVG rescales both denominator and weighted numerator as the maximum changes. Compilation reports its first cost and slower steady state rather than implying a break-even that was not observed. Quantization exercises distinguish grid approximation, zero-point clipping, per-row scales, odd-element packing and eight-bit containers; the seven-code example stores four bytes and trims its filler using the original shape. QAT compares STE to direct round and asks for the gradient under a changed loss without claiming that nonzero gradient proves improved task quality. Distillation exercises change masks/temperature/prefix length while preserving same-prefix/same-vocabulary comparisons; the multimodal exercise changes student context length and selects semantically equal answer rows. source_runtime_scope.details: The preparation prevents a reader from conflating the independent experiments. 13.17 ends with alternative PPO/DPO branches in its finite selection example;14 restarts architecture analysis from the earlier Transformer. The modern six-group comparison uses TinyStories409/51/52, seed42,240 updates and stated target counts; parameter counts change for RoPE, gates and sharing, and Q/K normalization has no formal training group. The seven MoE groups use180 updates on that story split and imperfect total/capacity-proxy matches, not the modern240-update budget or measured FLOPs. The efficiency chapter identifies its T.4 direct attributes-SFT source and changed four-query-head branch, cache correctness within each model, random one-KV projections and unequal-length-cache limit. Packing deliberately changes the training objective to assistant-only short text and records1/10 question-answer performance. Precision reloads the original single-head SFT source independently, records attempted versus successful updates and FP32 parameter/state storage. The standalone Flash fixture has different Q/K/V shape and low operation dtype, no full-model training/loss/optimizer, actual profiler-verified dispatch and a carefully restricted allocated-memory scope. These results cannot be combined into one end-to-end speed or quality claim. PTQ17.9 starts from a common FP32 model after120 further updates; its6/10 cannot be attributed to quantization compared with the original5/10 source. QAT is a separate350-update matched pair from the original SFT source, preserves validation/test ordering reversals and distinguishes float main weights from reloaded packed deployment. Activation calibration examples are not silently added to the weight-only formal model. Distillation uses trained but fallible direct-SFT/style/MoE teachers with distinct data and versions, hard generated text versus standard-answer-prefix cached logits, fixed264-ID mapping and immutable teacher targets. Same-initialization CE/CE+KL controls use the same batches and standard NLL denominator, while generation success/EOS remains a separate test. MoE story-teacher data is not the student32-item subset. Multimodal teachers are the specified11.5 all and12.12 joint branches; previously exposed audio-encoder frequencies are explicitly acknowledged, actual expanded-label rows replace the toy15/3 indices, and the smaller whole student even has a slightly larger image encoder. Its unchanged12 raw-ID sequences under blank images and all-circle decisions are preserved failures, not visual-capability success. Distillation followed by quantization has separate stages, with byte reduction and blue-to-ble failure retained. The following19 introduction/19.1 describes an independent synthetic-world integration product and distinguishes generating an action request, the runtime executing it, EOS, and correct task result. It does not claim the earlier standalone models are one trained artifact or that synthetic images/tones establish natural-image/speech ability. Limits of this review: source continuity and meaningful browser scope only; no GPU/long training, model/data download, independent formal experiment reproduction, full external-paper verification, or full19 body audit.
